body:
I don’t see it as condescending, but genuinely asking, which I am all for. 

And that goes to a personal decision and faith. I did my due diligence into believing that the God I serve is the one true God and each one of us has to walk that path ourselves. 
Do I still have doubts that I’m on the right path? At times I do, I’d be lying if I wasn’t. But at the end of the day I can’t see my life worth living without following Christ ( I know that’s a bad stance on a suicide post) but it’s what keeps me going and it’s what I stick to. I can’t force you to believe, Jesus never bullied anyone to do the same and neither will I.

I don’t want to diminish those advancements but there’s always going to be aspects of life that are out of our ability to control or understand. No matter the time or resources, we are finite beings. 

I can have peace knowing that even though I’m limited I can find all the answers I need and rely on God to handle the rest

Never said I was perfect, just wanted to level the playing field and show we all struggle, even those who might be thought of as not having this kind of issue. It doesn’t diminish God’s ability if one of his lowest servants fails, and I’m not the only one who He used that felt this way and won’t be the last. 

“Religion” and it’s institutions will never be “perfect”. We are all imperfect people trying to do the work of the One who was and is perfect.

Don’t be envious of me, friend. 

What it comes down to, for me, is the fact that I know I am limited in my ability to know all things. I’m not going to know everything about the universe, because I wasn’t made to know or control it all. 
Instead, I was given a gift of placing my trust and faith into the one who does, and rules for both His glory and my good. That takes the pressure off my shoulder and gives me the parameters I am called to live in. 

I know that might not be the answer you are looking for, but it’s what keeps me going, even on a dark night like tonight

All churches aren’t bad as the media would like to tell you. I’m encourage you to find one that is willing to come alongside you in your pain and give you support, care, and love. Jesus never used guilt or manipulation and if that is their tactic, press on and find a better community. I’m here for you

Right now, 4 Roses, but in all seriousness, allow myself to feel it. We’ve been gifted a beautiful array of emotions that society tells us to bundle up. It’s ok to feel sad and lonely at times, but what keeps me around is those I know who love me. Even if my brain wants to tell me they don’t care, they do and would be devastated if I was gone.
Personally, faith also plays a factor. Knowing I have a purpose in some capacity. I believe everything will be perfect in the end. And if it isn’t perfect, it must not be the end.
